title: IMAGINARY truncates complex text coefficients to 15 significant digits before returning binary64
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, IMAGINARY(inumber) parses complex text through Excel's 15-significant-digit decimal parser and flushes subnormal coefficients below DBL_MIN to 0. Thus IMAGINARY("1.5707963267948966i") returns 1.5707963267949 (0x3ff921fb54442cfa) instead of 0x3ff921fb54442d18, and IMAGINARY("3.141592653589793i") returns 3.14159265358979 (0x400921fb54442d11) instead of 0x400921fb54442d18. All 1,209 full-bank IMAGINARY rows match.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (jnt_parity_complex rows 482-494, 593) and CalcFunc-Evidence cache/w111-extended-regenerated-20260929/answers-imaginary.json.gz (Excel 16.0 build 20430); 1,209/1,209 full-bank rows match.
